articles.title: 迷走神经调节躯体疼痛和情感状态的脑干通路
articles.originalTitle: A brainstem pathway underlying vagal modulation of somatic pain and affective states.
articles.abstract: Vagus nerve stimulation (VNS) alleviates pain, yet the underlying neural mechanisms remain elusive. Furthermore, the caudal nucleus of the solitary tract (cNTS) receives vagal and somatic inputs, but how it transforms pain signals into behavior and how VNS modulates this processing remain unclear. Here we identified a population of cNTS neurons projecting to the periaqueductal gray (PAG) (cNTS(PAG)) as a critical node for VNS-dependent suppression of pain and negative affect in mice. Optogenetic activation of cNTS(PAG) neurons recapitulated pain behavior. These neurons exhibited modality-specific encoding of pain and predictive signals after learning. Inhibition of spinal input-defined cNTS(PAG) neurons reduced mechanical, but not thermal, nociception. Notably, VNS selectively dampened pain-evoked cNTS(PAG) activity by recruiting local inhibition and attenuated pain-evoked dopamine reductions in the nucleus accumbens through cNTS(PAG). Our findings establish a brainstem pathway with a previously unrecognized role in VNS modulation of pain and negative affect, providing insights for targeted neuromodulation in pain management.

sections.text: 迷走神经刺激（VNS）可缓解疼痛，但其潜在的神经机制仍不清楚。此外，孤束尾核（cNTS）接收迷走和躯体传入，但它如何将疼痛信号转化为行为以及VNS如何调节这一过程仍不明确。在此，我们鉴定了小鼠中投射至中脑导水管周围灰质（PAG）的cNTS神经元群体（cNTS(PAG)）作为VNS依赖性抑制疼痛和负面情绪的关键节点。cNTS(PAG)神经元的光遗传激活重现了疼痛行为。这些神经元在学习后表现出模态特异性的疼痛编码和预测信号。抑制脊髓输入定义的cNTS(PAG)神经元减少了机械性而非热性伤害感受。值得注意的是，VNS通过招募局部抑制选择性减弱了疼痛诱发的cNTS(PAG)活动，并通过cNTS(PAG)减轻了疼痛诱发的伏隔核多巴胺减少。我们的发现建立了一个脑干通路，该通路在VNS调节疼痛和负面情绪中具有先前未被认识的作用，为疼痛管理中的靶向神经调控提供了见解。

articles.title: 快速伤害感受器在机械性伤害防御行为和敏化中的核心作用
articles.originalTitle: Central role for fast nociceptors in mechanical nocifensive behavior and sensitization.
articles.abstract: Nociceptors, primary afferent nerve fibers that signal noxious stimuli, are broadly divided into slowly conducting unmyelinated C fibers and fast-conducting myelinated A fibers. Whereas C-nociceptors have been extensively studied, considerably less is known about the function of A-nociceptors. Here we demonstrate, combining genetic targeting of these fibers in mice with observations in human participants, a key involvement of A-nociceptors in mechanical nociceptive withdrawal reflexes and affective pain. In mice, optogenetic stimulation induced rapid and precise withdrawal reflexes as well as place aversion and facial expression changes consistent with pain affect, while inhibition strongly impaired mechanical nociceptive withdrawal reflexes. Prolonged A-nociceptor activation induced mechanical pain hypersensitivity and central sensitization. In a rare individual lacking thickly myelinated Abeta fibers, and in healthy participants during preferential Abeta-fiber nerve block, mechanical withdrawal reflexes were absent and mechanical pain perception reduced. Together, these findings identify fast-conducting mechano-nociceptors as essential drivers of nocifensive behaviors in mice and humans.

sections.text: 伤害感受器是传导伤害性刺激信号的初级传入神经纤维，大致分为慢传导无髓C纤维和快传导有髓A纤维。尽管C伤害感受器已被广泛研究，但关于A伤害感受器的功能所知甚少。在这里，我们结合小鼠中这些纤维的基因靶向与人类参与者的观察，证明了A伤害感受器在机械性伤害性撤退反射和情感性疼痛中的关键作用。在小鼠中，光遗传学刺激诱导快速且精准的撤退反射，以及位置厌恶和与疼痛情感一致的面部表情变化，而抑制则严重削弱了机械性伤害性撤退反射。持续的A伤害感受器激活诱导了机械性痛觉超敏和中枢敏化。在一名缺乏厚髓Aβ纤维的罕见个体中，以及在优先Aβ纤维神经阻滞期间的健康参与者中，机械性撤退反射缺失，机械性疼痛感知减弱。综上所述，这些发现确定了快传导机械伤害感受器是小鼠和人类伤害防御行为的关键驱动因素。

articles.originalTitle: Association of postoperative elevation of biomarkers of neural injury in blood with postoperative neurocognitive disorders in adults receiving general anaesthesia: a systematic review.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Perioperative neural injury, evidenced by postoperative elevation in neurofilament light (NfL) and glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP), is a potential biological basis of perioperative neurocognitive disorders. This systematic review evaluated the association between perioperative biomarker changes and postoperative cognitive disorder (POCD) and postoperative delirium (POD) in patients older than 60 yr undergoing surgery under general anaesthesia. METHODS: The protocol was registered (CRD42023479136). We searched MEDLINE, EMBASE, Cochrane Library, Scopus, Web of Science and CINAHL between 1990 and May 2025. We included studies reporting the association between biomarker changes and POCD or POD and used the Quality in Prognosis Studies tool for quality assessment. Results were summarised using effect direction plots and and GRADE approach. RESULTS: We identified 12 studies (1212 participants). Most studies of NfL reported a postoperative increase. Two studies reported the association between changes in NfL and POCD and three reported the association between changes in GFAP and POCD. All exhibited a high risk of bias and yielded inconsistent findings. A postoperative increase in NfL was associated with POD in four of six studies, with substantial variability in patient populations, adjustment for confounders, and statistical methods that limit interpretation. There was no consistent association between GFAP increase and POD. CONCLUSIONS: The significance of postoperative increases in plasma NfL and GFAP remains uncertain. Low-certainty evidence supports an association between an increase in NfL and POD, with very low certainty of evidence for an association between an increase in GFAP and POD, and either biomarker and POCD. Further high-quality studies are needed.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 围手术期神经损伤，表现为术后神经丝轻链（NfL）和胶质纤维酸性蛋白（GFAP）升高，是围手术期神经认知障碍的潜在生物学基础。本系统评价评估了全身麻醉下接受手术的60岁以上患者围手术期生物标志物变化与术后认知障碍（POCD）和术后谵妄（POD）之间的关联。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 方案已注册（CRD42023479136）。我们检索了1990年至2025年5月期间的MEDLINE、EMBASE、Cochrane图书馆、Scopus、Web of Science和CINAHL数据库。纳入报告生物标志物变化与POCD或POD之间关联的研究，并使用预后研究质量评估工具进行质量评估。结果采用效应方向图和GRADE方法进行总结。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 我们确定了12项研究（1212名受试者）。大多数关于NfL的研究报告了术后升高。两项研究报告了NfL变化与POCD之间的关联，三项报告了GFAP变化与POCD之间的关联。所有这些研究均存在高偏倚风险，且结果不一致。在六项研究中，有四项研究报告术后NfL升高与POD相关，但患者人群、混杂因素调整和统计方法存在显著异质性，限制了结果的解读。GFAP升高与POD之间无一致关联。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 术后血浆NfL和GFAP升高的意义仍不明确。低确定性证据支持NfL升高与POD之间存在关联，而GFAP升高与POD之间以及两种生物标志物与POCD之间的关联证据确定性极低。需要进一步开展高质量研究。

articles.title: 视频喉镜对比直接喉镜用于双腔气管插管：DOLVI多中心随机试验
articles.originalTitle: Videolaryngoscopy versus direct laryngoscopy for double-lumen tube intubation: the DOuble-Lumen intubation with VIdeolaryngoscopy (DOLVI) multicentre randomised trial.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Although videolaryngoscopy has shown benefits over direct laryngoscopy for tracheal intubation with single-lumen tubes, its role in double-lumen tube placement remains unclear. METHODS: In this multicentre, randomised trial conducted in four Spanish hospitals, we assigned adults undergoing surgery requiring lung isolation to receive double-lumen tube intubation with either videolaryngoscopy or direct laryngoscopy. The primary outcome was successful intubation on the first attempt. Secondary outcomes included glottic visualisation, ease of intubation, external airway manipulation, oesophageal intubation, double-lumen tube malposition, and other peri-intubation complications. RESULTS: Among the 916 patients enrolled, successful first-attempt intubation occurred in 388 of 458 (84.7%) participants in the videolaryngoscopy group and 352 of 458 (76.9%) in the direct laryngoscopy group (absolute risk difference 7.9 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI] 2.8-12.8; P=0.003). A total of 429 participants (93.7%) in the videolaryngoscopy group and 370 (80.8%) in the direct laryngoscopy group had good glottic visualisation (absolute risk difference 12.9%; 95% CI 8.6%-17.1%; P<0.001). Videolaryngoscopy was associated with a higher rate of easy intubation (81.9% vs 68.6%; absolute risk difference, 13.3%; 95% CI 7.8%-18.8%; P<0.001) and reduced external airway manipulation (28.6% vs 40.6%; P<0.001), loss of glottic view (4.4% vs 21.8%; P<0.001), oesophageal intubation (1.7% vs 4.6%; P=0.014), and double-lumen tube malposition (7.6% vs 12.4%; P=0.016). Intubation time and other complications were similar between groups. CONCLUSIONS: Among patients undergoing surgery requiring lung isolation, videolaryngoscopy increased first-attempt success and improved glottic visualisation while reducing procedural difficulty in double-lumen tube placement compared with direct laryngoscopy. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT06401486.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 尽管视频喉镜在单腔管气管插管中已显示出优于直接喉镜的益处，但其在双腔管置入中的作用仍不明确。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 在这项于西班牙四家医院进行的多中心随机试验中，我们将接受需要肺隔离手术的成人患者分配至接受视频喉镜或直接喉镜引导下的双腔管插管。主要结局是首次尝试成功插管。次要结局包括声门可视化、插管难易度、外部气道操作、食管插管、双腔管位置不当以及其他围插管期并发症。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 在纳入的916例患者中，视频喉镜组458例中有388例（84.7%）首次尝试成功插管，直接喉镜组458例中有352例（76.9%）（绝对风险差7.9个百分点；95%置信区间[CI] 2.8-12.8；P=0.003）。视频喉镜组429例（93.7%）和直接喉镜组370例（80.8%）获得良好的声门可视化（绝对风险差12.9%；95% CI 8.6%-17.1%；P<0.001）。视频喉镜与更高的易插管率（81.9% vs 68.6%；绝对风险差13.3%；95% CI 7.8%-18.8%；P<0.001）、减少的外部气道操作（28.6% vs 40.6%；P<0.001）、声门视野丢失（4.4% vs 21.8%；P<0.001）、食管插管（1.7% vs 4.6%；P=0.014）和双腔管位置不当（7.6% vs 12.4%；P=0.016）相关。插管时间和其他并发症两组相似。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 在接受需要肺隔离手术的患者中，与直接喉镜相比，视频喉镜提高了首次尝试成功率并改善了声门可视化，同时减少了双腔管置入的操作难度。

articles.title: 七氟烷和丙泊酚麻醉的环境足迹和生态毒性：一项回顾性观察建模研究
articles.originalTitle: The environmental footprint and ecotoxicity of sevoflurane and propofol anaesthesia: a retrospective observational modelling study.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: General anaesthesia contributes to healthcare-related environmental impacts through anaesthetics with high global warming potential and ecotoxicity. Inhalational anaesthetics have high global warming potential, whereas propofol-based total i.v. anaesthesia (TIVA) has potential for aquatic toxicity. However, the lowest global warming potential fluorinated anaesthetics used, such as sevoflurane, degrade to trifluoroacetic acid (TFA), which is accumulating irreversibly in the environment. We compared the water contamination potential across three anaesthetic strategies: TIVA with propofol, target-controlled inhalational anaesthesia (TCIA) with sevoflurane, and manually optimised low-flow sevoflurane anaesthesia. METHODS: This retrospective observational modelling study included adult general anaesthesia procedures from three French university hospitals, each using one strategy (TIVA, TCIA, or manual sevoflurane). Anaesthetic consumption was obtained from pharmacy records. Using published physicochemical data and established regulatory concentration thresholds, we calculated estimated instantaneous and long-term water contamination potential for propofol and sevoflurane-derived TFA. RESULTS: TIVA, TCIA, and manually optimised sevoflurane strategies were used in 10 717, 7207, and 15 461 cases, respectively. In a 10-yr simulation assuming 1000 h of general anaesthesia per year, TFA accumulated linearly to 29-35 million m(3) in halogenated strategies, whereas propofol contamination reached a steady plateau after  approximately 5 yr in the TIVA strategy to 2.6-2.9 million m(3) depending on waste management. CONCLUSIONS: TIVA with propofol generated less water contamination and avoided TFA release while producing locally biodegradable residues. Conversely, sevoflurane-derived TCIA and manual methods led to higher TFA emissions, contributing to its global irreversible accumulation. These findings warrant consideration when minimising the environmental impacts of anaesthetic practises.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 全身麻醉通过具有高全球变暖潜势和生态毒性的麻醉剂导致医疗相关环境影响。吸入麻醉剂具有高全球变暖潜势，而基于丙泊酚的全静脉麻醉（TIVA）具有水生毒性潜力。然而，使用的全球变暖潜势最低的氟化麻醉剂，如七氟醚，会降解为三氟乙酸（TFA），该物质在环境中不可逆地积累。我们比较了三种麻醉策略的水污染潜力：丙泊酚TIVA、七氟醚靶控吸入麻醉（TCIA）和手动优化的低流量七氟醚麻醉。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 这项回顾性观察性建模研究纳入了来自三家法国大学医院的成人全身麻醉手术，每家医院使用一种策略（TIVA、TCIA或手动七氟醚）。麻醉消耗量来自药房记录。利用已发表的物理化学数据和既定的监管浓度阈值，我们计算了丙泊酚和七氟醚衍生TFA的估计即时和长期水污染潜力。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: TIVA、TCIA和手动优化七氟醚策略分别用于10717例、7207例和15461例手术。在假设每年1000小时全身麻醉的10年模拟中，卤化策略中TFA线性积累至29-35百万立方米，而丙泊酚污染在TIVA策略中约5年后达到稳定平台，根据废物管理方式不同为2.6-2.9百万立方米。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 丙泊酚TIVA产生较少的水污染，避免了TFA释放，同时产生可局部生物降解的残留物。相反，七氟醚衍生的TCIA和手动方法导致更高的TFA排放，助长了其全球不可逆积累。在最小化麻醉实践的环境影响时，这些发现值得考虑。

We compared the water contamination potential across three anaesthetic strategies: TIVA with propofol, target-controlled inhalational anaesthesia (TCIA) with sevoflurane, and manually optimised low-flow sevoflurane anaesthesia. METHODS: This retrospective observational modelling study included adult general anaesthesia procedures from three French university hospitals, each using one strategy (TIVA, TCIA, or manual sevoflurane). Anaesthetic consumption was obtained from pharmacy records. Using published physicochemical data and established regulatory concentration thresholds, we calculated estimated instantaneous and long-term water contamination potential for propofol and sevoflurane-derived TFA. RESULTS: TIVA, TCIA, and manually optimised sevoflurane strategies were used in 10 717, 7207, and 15 461 cases, respectively. In a 10-yr simulation assuming 1000 h of general anaesthesia per year, TFA accumulated linearly to 29-35 million m(3) in halogenated strategies, whereas propofol contamination reached a steady plateau after  approximately 5 yr in the TIVA strategy to 2.6-2.9 million m(3) depending on waste management. CONCLUSIONS: TIVA with propofol generated less water contamination and avoided TFA release while producing locally biodegradable residues. Conversely, sevoflurane-derived TCIA and manual methods led to higher TFA emissions, contributing to its global irreversible accumulation. These findings warrant consideration when minimising the environmental impacts of anaesthetic practises.
